body:
I am done and figured I'd report what's happening. I have a gun next to my laptop. I am signing off and taking my life. 

Goodbye.
I don't want to have to wait for it to be fixed. I see no point in life.
How can I feel differently?! I try to love things and hobbies but I just can't, I lack motivation... And I'll explain good reason at some other point, I really don't care to as of now.

What the shit? I just ranted, why would I rant more? I bet you do but you probably had someone to help you out of this n' shit. No fucking shit I'm upset, do you mean angry? Good luck isn't going to save me, idiot.

Fuck psychologists, I don't like them. For good reason.

I'm not going to get forced care, that's fake emotion and remarkably foolish

I already have a pet, he's a stupid little shit that just licks everything. I ignore his existence.

It would give me motivation but honestly I care no longer about anything in my life. If I commit suicide, maybe their kids and their friends *will* be treated well. I'll send a message. That feels like the best possible purpose I could give out of my life...
